events.title: 360 ALLSTARS — World Tour 2026
events.description: This phenomenal physical performance at QPAC explores all forms of rotation, connecting street culture with elite artistry through a cast of World Champion and World Record holding artists, accompanied by a live soundtrack. Expect a spectacular fusion of dance, music, and performance art.

events.title: PRAMKICKER — MO Theatre at QPAC
events.description: MO Theatre presents the international hit play PRAMKICKER by Sadie Hasler at QPAC. This production is described as a vulnerable and raw love-letter to the modern woman, offering contemporary theatrical insight.

events.title: Rusalka — Opera Queensland
events.description: Opera Queensland presents the breathtaking opera Rusalka at QPAC. This shimmering fairytale explores themes of love, sacrifice, and longing through a classic operatic narrative.

events.title: Beetlejuice The Musical — QPAC
events.description: Based on the Tim Burton film, Beetlejuice The Musical tells the story of Lydia Deetz, a strange teenager who encounters a deceased couple and a mischievous demon. Catch this lively musical for a limited season at QPAC's Lyric Theatre.

events.title: Sister Act — Savoyards Musical Theatre Brisbane
events.description: Savoyards Musical Theatre Brisbane proudly presents the Queensland Community Theatre premiere of Sister Act. This high-energy musical promises a fabulous and entertaining show.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence — GOMA Exhibition
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA) — South Brisbane
events.description: This major exhibition at GOMA showcases the immersive and sensory work of internationally renowned artist Olafur Eliasson. Experience a multi-sensory journey through his three-decade career, including interactive installations like Riverbed and a communal Lego city.

events.title: Divine Connections: Oleographs from Bengaluru — QAGOMA Free Exhibition
events.description: Explore the interplay of faith, visual culture, and daily life through stunning and rare oleographs from the late 1800s, showcased in this free exhibition at QAGOMA. Created in collaboration with conservationists from Bengaluru, India.

events.title: Dearly Departed — Free Exhibition, State Library of Queensland
events.location: State Library of Queensland — South Brisbane
events.description: This fascinating free exhibition at the State Library of Queensland delves into the often-taboo subjects of death and dying. Discover historical perspectives and cultural interpretations through various displays.

events.title: The Explainer Series: First Nations Astronomy
events.description: Part of 'The Explainer Series', this lecture explores First Nations astronomy, offering insights into Indigenous knowledge systems and their deep understanding of the cosmos. Ideal for curious and open-minded audiences.

events.title: Brisbane Theosophy Public Lecture
events.description: Join Nicky Bassett and Tony Petcopoulos for a public lecture at the Brisbane Theosophical Society, exploring profound ideas about consciousness, cosmic law, and universal brotherhood. The society is a community hub for insightful discussions.

events.title: Brisbane Breakfast Club — New Farm
events.location: Savour Cafe, Merthyr Village Shopping Centre — New Farm
events.description: The Brisbane Breakfast Club invites people of all ages to a casual breakfast meetup at Savour Cafe in New Farm. Enjoy consistent quality food and coffee in a bright space while connecting with new people in a friendly, community-oriented setting.

events.title: Vintage Urban Photography Session
events.location: Meeting Point: King George Square — Brisbane CBD
events.description: Join a relaxed urban photography walk, starting at King George Square, to capture Brisbane's urban character with a nostalgic vintage aesthetic. This casual and creative meetup welcomes all skill levels, whether you shoot film, digital, or mobile.

events.title: Bonfire Night — Warwick / Stanthorpe Area
events.location: Stanthorpe area / Granite Belt (day trip from Brisbane)
events.description: Experience an extraordinary outdoor winter night event in the Granite Belt region, featuring sensational bonfires, mesmerizing flame shows, dazzling pyrotechnics, and captivating fire twirlers. Perfect for a social and adventurous day trip from Brisbane.

events.title: Maleny Artisan Winter Creative Markets and Workshops
events.description: Head to the scenic Sunshine Coast Hinterland for community-focused creative markets and hands-on workshops in Maleny. This event offers a chance to explore artisan crafts and participate in various creative activities, ideal for a day trip.

events.title: Australian Brandenburg Orchestra — Italian Serenatas
events.description: The Australian Brandenburg Orchestra returns to QPAC with 'Italian Serenatas,' a vibrant celebration of Baroque Italy. Embark on a dramatic musical journey through classical compositions, beginning July 2nd.

events.title: ASPG-Q: AI in Parliament – Risks, Opportunities and What's Next?
events.description: This event, hosted by ASPG-Q, features a panel discussion on Artificial Intelligence in Parliament, exploring its risks, opportunities, and future implications. It's highly relevant for those interested in technology, governance, and systems thinking.

events.title: BIYMF 2026 Winners Concert and Award Ceremony
events.description: Brisbane City Hall hosts the BIYMF 2026 Winners Concert and Award Ceremony, showcasing top young musicians from the Brisbane International Youth Music Festival. Enjoy live performances by emerging talent.

events.title: Resin River Art Workshop
events.description: Engage in a hands-on creative art workshop in Brisbane City where you'll pour and craft your own resin art piece on a large platter. This event encourages a social and creative evening, allowing BYO drinks and snacks.
